11.2 Proposal to Adjust Schedule

L. Fernandez proposed that the committee consider moving to a bi-monthly meeting schedule, with an additional informal working session in alternate months. The proposal was put forward on the basis that some routine items could be handled by correspondence, and that the change might reduce the administrative load on members.

Discussion followed. Several members expressed support for the idea, noting that the agenda is often light during non-peak periods. Other members, including R. Okafor and A. Kowalski, expressed concern that a reduced meeting frequency could delay important decisions on track maintenance priorities and safety matters. It was also noted that the ECRIB board expects a monthly reporting cadence from the committee.

The chair noted that any change to the meeting frequency would require a formal amendment to the TMCC charter. The committee agreed that this is not a matter to be decided without further consultation.

**Moved:** L. Fernandez
**Seconded:** S. Patel
**Outcome:** That the committee adopt a bi-monthly meeting schedule, effective from July 2019, with an informal working session in alternate months. **Defeated.**

The chair invited discussion on the frequency of TMCC meetings. The current schedule is a monthly meeting, held on the second Tuesday of each month.

11.2 Proposal to Adjust Schedule

L. Fernandez proposed that the committee consider moving to a bi-monthly meeting schedule, with an additional informal working session in alternate months. The proposal was put forward on the basis that some routine items could be handled by correspondence, and that the change might reduce the administrative load on members.

It was also noted that the ECRIB board expects a monthly reporting cadence from the committee.

Notes: Sleeper replacement to be done 02/07 – small crew, 3 hr night window. Coordinate with tamping supervisor for handback.

WO-2025-0395 | Signal post lamp – Signal 214 | Priority 4
Status: OPEN (raised 2025-06-08)
Location: Up main, signal 214
Description: Lamp housing cracked, moisture ingress suspected. Lamp still functioning but intermittent flicker reported by driver 07/06. Replacement housing ordered. No date for delivery yet – follow up with stores.
Notes: Check again in July. If housing not arrived, consider temporary sealant.

documents.content:
WO-2025-0392 | Ballast cleaning – Down main, km 87.4 – 87.9 | Priority 2
Status: IN PROGRESS (raised 2025-06-05)
Location: Down main, between bridge 34 and bridge 35
Description: Ballast fouled, poor drainage noted after May rain event. Shoulder ballast contaminated with clay – mud pumping visible at 3 locations. Ballast cleaner scheduled to pass through on 12/07. Pre-cleaning check of formation completed 26/06 – no soft spots found. 
Notes: Keep an eye on track level until cleaner passes. If pumping worsens, raise to priority 1.

WO-2025-0405 | Level crossing – Repaint of stop lines and signage | Priority 4
Status: OPEN (raised 2025-06-20)
Location: Level crossing, Gowrie Road, km 112.7
Description: Paint faded, stop sign reflective sheeting peeling at edges. Reported by local council 18/06. Paint crew available week of 14/07. Sign replacement ordered – expected delivery 10/07.
Notes: Coordinate with council for temporary stop signs if paint crew delayed. Otherwise no action needed until mid-July.

WO-2025-0407 | Bridge inspection – Bridge 42, timber deck | Priority 2
Status: IN PROGRESS (raised 2025-06-22)
Location: Bridge 42, up main, km 98.3
Description: Annual detailed inspection due. Last inspection 2024-04-11 – no significant defects. This year’s inspection scheduled for 08/07. Access required – underbridge unit booked. 
Notes: Check bearing condition and any signs of termite activity. Timber deck had minor surface checks last year – monitor.

WO-2025-0409 | Vegetation – Overhanging branches, km 133.0 – 133.4 | Priority 3
Status: OPEN (raised 2025-06-24)
Location: Down side, between km 133.0 and 133.4
Description: Tree branches encroaching on clearance. Reported by driver 23/06. Assessed 25/06 – branches approx. 1.5m from overhead wire at closest point. Trimming crew available 10/07. 
Notes: If high winds forecast before 10/07, re-check clearance. Do not trim without overhead wire crew present.

WO-2025-0411 | Drainage – Blocked culvert, km 121.8 | Priority 2
Status: IN PROGRESS (raised 2025-06-25)
Location: Down side, culvert under track
Description: Culvert partially blocked with silt and debris. Water backing up along cess. Inspected 26/06 – blockage at inlet, approx. 60% blocked. Excavator booked for 09/07. 
Notes: Monitor water level if rain forecast. Inlet to be cleared and outlet checked for scour.

WO-2025-0413 | Rail defect – Ultrasonic testing, km 155.0 – 156.2 | Priority 1
Status: OPEN (raised 2025-06-26)
Location: Up main, both rails
Description: Follow-up testing required after grinding completed 20/06. Initial ultrasonic test flagged possible surface defect at km 155.6 – grinding may have removed it. Retest scheduled 30/06. 
Notes: If defect still present, rail to be replaced. Do not close WO until retest results reviewed.

WO-2025-0415 | Platform – Concrete spalling, platform 2, Yarramundi | Priority 3
Status: OPEN (raised 2025-06-27)
Location: Platform 2, Yarramundi station, approx. mid-platform
Description: Concrete spalling on platform edge, small area approx. 300mm x 200mm. No exposed reinforcement yet. Reported by station staff 26/06. Patch repair scheduled 15/07.
Notes: Isolate area with barrier tape until repaired. Check for further spalling along platform edge.

WO-2025-0417 | Turnout – Points adjustment, turnout 47 | Priority 2
Status: IN PROGRESS (raised 2025-06-28)
Location: Down main, turnout 47, km 89.6
Description: Points throwing slowly – detected in June points inspection. Measured throw time 3.2s (acceptable up to 2.5s). Lubrication and adjustment carried out 28/06. Retest scheduled 01/07.
Notes: If throw time still high, check slide chairs and drive rod. May need replacement of point machine if no improvement.

documents.content:
**Maintenance Work Log – North Coast & Tablelands Region**
Compiled by: M. O’Connor, Maintenance Program Coordinator
Period: 30/06/2025 – 14/07/2025 (entries added continuously)
Status codes: OPEN / IN PROGRESS / COMPLETED / CANCELLED
Priority: 1 = urgent, 2 = high, 3 = routine, 4 = low

**WO-2025-0418 | Level crossing – Surface repairs, km 14.2, Teralba Rd | Priority 2**
Status: IN PROGRESS (raised 2025-06-30)
Location: Teralba Rd level crossing, single line
Description: Rubber panels lifting at edge of boom gate. Reported by road users 28/06. Inspected 30/06 – two panels loose, one cracked. Replacement panels ordered (ETA 16/07). Crossing surface to be patched with cold mix in the interim.
Notes: Monitor panels daily until replacement. If panel becomes fully dislodged, close crossing to road traffic and advise TMCC immediately.

---

**WO-2025-0419 | Fencing – Stock fence damage, km 47.5 – 48.1 | Priority 3**
Status: OPEN (raised 2025-07-01)
Location: Both sides, between km 47.5 and 48.1
Description: Routine inspection found several broken posts and sagging wire. Likely caused by cattle pushing through. No stock sighted on track at time of inspection. Fencing crew scheduled for 22/07.
Notes: Advise adjacent landholder of repair date. Check for any new breaks before crew arrives.

---

**WO-2025-0420 | Signal – Lamp failure, signal 23, Murwillumbah line | Priority 1**
Status: COMPLETED (raised 2025-07-01, completed 2025-07-02)
Location: Signal 23, down side, approaching Murwillumbah station
Description: Lamp reported out by train crew 01/07. Signal showed steady red – no approach aspect. Electrician attended 02/07, replaced lamp unit and checked lens alignment. Signal tested and returned to service 14:30.
Notes: No further action. Monitor for repeat failure – lamp was 3 months old. Consider checking batch from same supplier.

---

**WO-2025-0421 | Track – Geometry correction, km 88.9 – 89.4 | Priority 2**
Status: OPEN (raised 2025-07-02)
Location: Up main, km 88.9 to 89.4
Description: Geometry car identified lateral alignment issues – 4 locations exceeding alert level, 1 exceeding intervention level. Speed restriction (60 km/h) applied 02/07 pending correction. Tamping booked for 16/07.
Notes: Do not lift speed restriction until post-tamp geometry car run completed. Coordinate with points adjustment crew working at turnout 47 – overlapping area.

---

**WO-2025-0422 | Vegetation – Tree limb over track, km 102.3, near Doon Doon | Priority 2**
Status: IN PROGRESS (raised 2025-07-03)
Location: Up side, tree limb overhanging track
Description: Reported by track patrol 03/07. Large limb approx. 4m long overhanging the track, clear of overhead wire by approx. 2m at present. Arborist assessed 04/07 – limb to be removed, not just trimmed. Removal crew booked for 11/07.
Notes: If wind forecast above 40 km/h before removal, inspect limb and consider speed restriction. Do not let crew work under limb without spotter.

---

**WO-2025-0423 | Culvert – Scour repair, km 121.8 (outlet side) | Priority 2**
Status: IN PROGRESS (raised 2025-07-03)
Location: Down side, outlet of culvert at km 121.8
Description: Follow-up inspection of culvert cleared under WO-2025-0411 found scour hole at outlet, approx. 600mm deep and 1.2m wide. Rock beaching required. Material ordered – rock delivery expected 14/07. Repair crew scheduled 17/07.
Notes: Monitor scour hole size until repaired. If hole deepens to 1m, close track and advise engineering.

---

**WO-2025-0424 | Station – Graffiti removal, Casino station | Priority 4**
Status: OPEN (raised 2025-07-04)
Location: Station building, platform side wall and waiting shelter
Description: Graffiti reported by station staff 03/07. Extent approx. 6m² across two surfaces. Cleaning crew available 24/07. No offensive content – standard tags only.
Notes: Photograph before cleaning for records. Check CCTV footage for identification (request from station office).
